notes: Updates only when the host types !update in chat. Nothing is checked, downloaded or changed until somebody asks.
An update says in chat what changed, including anything from releases this copy skipped.
Several copies of the tool on one table post that between them once, instead of one identical message each.
It posts what changed, or that the tool is already current, or that the repository could not be reached.
Update checks are staggered, so many copies on one table no longer all fire at once.
